text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I gave it... I gave it my all...! 
Everything I have, out there on the 
track...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about that...?! How was it...?! This 
masterpiece—...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooo!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that push from the fourth 
corner?! What an incredible late kick, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Her tenacity at the end was so cool too~! 
Charging up the slope on that rough 
late-June turf!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I might wanna do "this" again!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Because it feels so good! Everyone's 
applause and their burning gazes!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, almost like— Racing against "Kitasan 
Black."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-san... ...Since we have the chance, 
why don't you raise your hand?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hand...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The finale of the stage has to be 
graced by an Umamusume responding to her 
audience!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ――Come on!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaaah----! Kiseki---! Crown---! 
Vivloooooos!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
That was fun! It got so intense! It was 
the best Takarazuka ever! Thank youーー!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Still—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm not done yet...! Today's run 
won't be the end of me!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Even if what Kiseki-san creates resembles 
Kita-chan's festival! Even so—!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Until we meet again, I shall put my life 
on the line. I, Dia, will return even 
stronger……!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Me too!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep getting stronger, too! A 
protagonist's growth never stops, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Until we meet again, let us compete! 
Toward the center of the era we once 
envisioned!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "Strongest Deciding Match Arc" 
came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the Umamusume with a sense of 
fulfillment, excitement, and a lingering 
thirst for more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—And then, an uncountably vast amount of 
time passed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Takarazuka Kinen. While 
reading the manga Kiseki drew, I was 
blindsided by some utterly wild 
expressions.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I'm sorry! I just couldn't resist 
writing the usual trope!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um, in manga, several months pass between 
major milestones, right?! So...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'll fix it up~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki crosses out the text in the manga 
and goes right back to drawing the next 
panel.
choice_data_list:
Well, it definitely marked a good 
milestone.

Well, it definitely marked a good 
milestone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember the declaration Kiseki made on 
New Year's. Back then, she――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who triumphs in this 
ultimate showdown will truly be the 
"protagonist of the new era."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist of this era—is gonna be 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At the Takarazuka Kinen, she truly seemed 
to embody that declaration."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the center of all these rivalries, at 
the heart of this generational swell, is 
Kiseki. So much so that it's impossible to 
imagine anyone else as the protagonist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Because Crown-chan, Vivlos-chan, and 
Dia-chan all gathered at that Takarazuka.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because the three of them came, we were 
able to create the ultimate, thrilling 
'Battle for the Strongest' arc that got 
everyone excited.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still, my story doesn't end here!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Part three will begin shortly.
choice_data_list:
...! Have you already thought of 
something?

...! Have you already thought of 
something?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, our next goal is the 'Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown'!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Only two Umamusume in history have ever 
achieved it! To a realm even Kita-chan 
couldn't reach, onward we go!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The trial race for that is the Kyoto 
Daishoten!? How will Kiseki's challenge 
play out!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Talk about a thrilling storyline, 
wouldn't you say?
choice_data_list:
Then, you've got to take 1st place in the 
Kyoto Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, roger that! It's way more fun that 
way anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smiles break out on both our faces. Our 
next goal is 1st place in the Kyoto 
Daishoten.
